documents.title: PersonalSong Studio README
documents.description: Top-level overview, setup, Plex/Google Home/Alexa playback, troubleshooting. NOTE: still describes the original MusicGen/HuggingFace + Suno approach on port 8000 — the live engine is ACE-Step via serve.py on :8088. Pending a rewrite to match reality.

documents.title: Environment template
documents.description: Sample .env: OLLAMA_BASE_URL/MODEL, HF_TOKEN (legacy), MUSIC_LIBRARY_PATH, PLEX_LIBRARY_PATH. The real .env is gitignored.

documents.title: App config template
documents.description: Committed template of the runtime config (paths, Plex url/token/section placeholders, ollama_model qwen3:8b, default language/genres/duration). The live app_config.json is gitignored as a secret.

documents.title: Plex + Smart Home Setup Guide
documents.description: Step-by-step guide to play generated songs on Plex via Google Home / Alexa voice commands.

documents.title: Claude project settings
documents.description: Per-project Claude Code settings and a VS Code launch config for the server.

documents.title: ACE-Step Singing Engine
documents.description: Singleton ACE-Step pipeline (bf16). build_tags (genre/mood/vocal/language/voice tags, ~30 genres), normalize_lyrics, ensure_name_in_lyrics, apply_pronunciation, generate_song (incl. audio2audio), detect_gender, levers_to_ref_strength. Patches torchaudio.save -> soundfile.

documents.title: Source / Stem Engine (Demucs)
documents.description: Demucs two-stem separation; source acquisition (yt-dlp, local, upload, video audio-extract, CD rip); WAV->MP3 transcode. Drives FFmpeg + yt-dlp + Demucs as subprocesses.

documents.title: Cover Orchestrator (Seed-VC)
documents.description: Full voice-clone cover pipeline: Demucs(source+ACE) -> Seed-VC f0-conditioned conversion -> mix over chosen backing. Seed-VC runs in its own venv as a subprocess.

documents.title: Spoken-Dedication Voice Clone
documents.description: Isolate an artist's vocal slice (Demucs) and re-voice the spoken dedication via Seed-VC (non-f0 speech model). available()/isolate_reference()/convert()/clone_dedication().

documents.title: Dedication / TTS Engine
documents.description: edge-tts native voices (8 langs); native wording per [style][language][tone] (radio/concert x heartfelt/warm/festive) + prosody; concert crowd bed; prepend-to-song; optional Seed-VC re-voice.

documents.title: Cover-Art Engine
documents.description: PIL procedural gradient cover (always) + optional SDXL-Turbo AI cover in a subprocess with fallback.

documents.title: Whisper ASR (shared)
documents.description: Lazy whisper 'base' singleton; transcribe spoken names and source-song lyrics.

documents.title: App Config + Dictionaries
documents.description: JSON-backed config, pronunciations, singers, voices, and the overnight queue with thread-locked saves.

documents.title: FFmpeg PATH bootstrap
documents.description: Prepends the vendored FFmpeg 7.1 shared bin to PATH so torchcodec loads; imported at every entry point.

documents.title: FastAPI app
documents.description: Builds the app, mounts 12 routers under /api/*, serves static/index.html, /health. version 2.2.0.

documents.title: In-process launcher
documents.description: uvicorn.run('main:app', :8088) in-process so acestep resolves; asserts acestep importable before serving.

documents.title: Lyrics router
documents.description: /api/lyrics/generate (Ollama, think=False, keep_alive=0, duration-scaled structure, name-twice rule), /models.

documents.title: Audio router
documents.description: /api/audio/generate, /generate_based (levers), /generate_cover (voice clone), /stream/{song_id}. Serialized GPU executor; Plex + YT side-effects.

documents.title: Source router
documents.description: /api/source/list, /upload, /url, /local, /drives, /cd/tracks, /cd/rip.

documents.title: Media router
documents.description: /api/media/transcribe-name, /pronounce-preview, /dedication-draft, /add-dedication (prepend to an uploaded song, optional artist-voice clone).

documents.title: Library & Extras routers
documents.description: library: songs list/stream/delete, settings (GPU/ACE probe). extras: cover art, download, bundle zip, karaoke stems, play page, QR greeting card.

documents.title: Config & Voices routers
documents.description: Settings + pronunciation + singers CRUD, Plex status/sections probes; named reference-voice library.

documents.title: Batch & Queue router
documents.description: /api/batch/generate (album mode) and /api/queue/* (add/list/clear/run overnight).

documents.title: YouTube Music router + manager
documents.description: Header auth, upload one/all, list/delete, playlists, auto-upload toggle.

documents.title: Prompt export
documents.description: Export a ready-to-paste prompt/lyrics package for external generators (e.g. Suno).

documents.title: Web UI
documents.description: Single-page creation studio + YouTube Music management page served from /static.

documents.title: Singer presets
documents.description: 10 curated ACE-Step voice presets (timbre descriptor + stable seed + languages).

documents.title: Pronunciations
documents.description: Per-language phonetic respellings of names for correct singing.

documents.title: Generation queue
documents.description: Pending overnight generation jobs (failures retained for retry).

documents.title: Service installer
documents.description: Installs QI_PersonalSong NSSM service (serve.py, AppDirectory C:\PersonalSong, :8088, rotating logs\service.log) using C:\QIH\engine\bin\nssm.exe.

documents.title: Manual run scripts
documents.description: Start the app from the venv (run_server) and run the overnight generation queue (run_queue).

documents.title: Demo / batch scripts
documents.description: Native-language singer demo, bulk generation, and summary builders used during development.

documents.title: Service log
documents.description: QI_PersonalSong stdout/stderr (rotated at 1 MB). Also a top-level server.log / tunnel.log from manual runs.

documents.title: QI Ecosystem Registry (personalsong)
documents.description: Registry entry: id personalsong, path C:\PersonalSong, UI port 8088 (pre-registry; recommended block 8500-8599 / 8502), family_tier=cousin, integrates_with m2v, loopback-only, not internet-exposed, added 2026-06-10.

documents.title: QI Ecosystem Map
